column1: # Candidates — every song we want on a card and do not have yet.
# Generated by ImportCharts (make import-charts). One list: SK charts,
# CZ charts and wishlist entries all merged, best-charting first.
# To finish a song: paste its Spotify link into the link column, then
# move the first four fields into data/songs.csv and drop the line here.
# `make cards` validates every link, so a typo cannot reach a card.
# The first four columns are the data/songs.csv shape: fill in year and
# link, then copy those four fields across and delete the line here.
